text:
Lena Ortiz: Quick ask — StratoCore agreed to share cost inputs for our unit-econ model. Need slot-level exports (hourly preferred) covering: capacity buckets, reserved tiers (1/3/12mo), spot prices, eviction probabilities by region, replacement lead time distribution, listing fees (pct or per-hour), rack/colocation pass-throughs, and one example invoice that shows reserve credits.

Samir Rao: Got it. Do we need historical realized eviction counts or just vendor forecasts? Also prefer per-slot ids so we can join to our job traces.

Lena Ortiz: Historical + forecast if available for last 30d. Per-slot ID required. If hourly impossible, daily with a 15m sample window is acceptable.

Tom Blake: Finance notes: include price_reserved_usd_per_gpu_hour, price_spot_usd_per_gpu_hour, listing_fee_pct_or_usd, and billing_proration (hourly, round_up, partial_minute). Also show how reserve credits are calculated (pseudocode) and whether credits are applied per-invoice or as end-of-month true-up.

Nadia Gomez: Also ask StratoCore whether blended usage is reported as aggregated SKU lines or detailed per-slot lines on invoices. That affects traceability and our reconciliation.

partner-bot: Suggested minimal CSV schema + sample row ->
slot_id,region,zone,timestamp_iso,gpu_type,reserved_tier_months,price_reserved_usd_per_gpu_hour,price_spot_usd_per_gpu_hour,history_spot_hours,history_eviction_count,eviction_prob_forecast,replace_lead_median_minutes,replace_lead_p95_minutes,slot_bucket_count,listing_fee_pct,rack_pass_through_usd,billing_proration_model,invoice_line_example
sc-slot-092,us-west-1a,A,2026-03-25T08:00:00Z,H100-80GB,12,2.60,0.90,410,2,0.0025,30,120,16,0.12,10.00,hourly,"Usage: $416.00; Reserve credit: -$180.00; Marketplace fee: $1.92; Net: $237.92"

Lena Ortiz: Perfect. Two final asks before I send to StratoCore: 1) request CSV deliverable (SFTP/GCS) covering last 30 days at hourly granularity or daily+15m samples; 2) a short doc paragraph or pseudocode for reserve_credit calc and timing. Also request eviction distribution per-region (median + p95) and any SLA wording.

Samir Rao: I'll prepare the exact email/spec and include a small SQL join example joining on slot_id.

Tom Blake: Please ask vendor if invoice numbers are tax-inclusive and whether marketplace takes are shown as % or line items.

partner-bot: Ticket PC-5007 created: "StratoCore 50 hourly slot export + reserve crediting + invoice examples". Owner: partner-ops. ETA: 72h.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks everyone — will follow up once vendor responds. :white_check_mark:
